title: Momoi Airi — Intro To Tea Ceremony〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? You wanna try some matcha?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You spoke so passionately about doing tea ceremonies that I couldn't help but feel a little interested.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, you certainly seemed to enjoy talking about it yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Please try to forget about that...
I feel embarrassed for going as in-depth as I did.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm with Minori on this one. I also found your story very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That was actually what the three of us talked about after school during practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We all sort of wished that we were in attendance when the tea ceremony club did a demonstration at the School Festival.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
It's great to hear that you're all so interested!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I'd like to do something for them since they're expressing so much interest in tea ceremonies...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that might work...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Leave this one to me! I know what we can do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?
Weekend
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we'll be having a tea ceremony demo today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you for doing this, Airi.
Not only are you providing the space for us to do this, but also the equipment and sweets.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is the least I could do.
I mean, seeing all of you show so much interest in this made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, so this is the container for the tea...! And these are the tea bowls!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. The two in the front are the ones I usually use. Shizuku brought the other two.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Interesting... Your bowls are more vibrantly colored than I was expecting. They feel nice and casual.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree, and these pink accents are so cute. Just like you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Wait, hang on... You use these on a regular basis?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Sometimes I get these massive cravings for matcha. Especially when I bring home some seasonal Japanese sweets!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If anything, the bowls Shizuku brought are more like what you'd normally see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: True. You said that you borrowed these from your mom?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. She plays the koto, but she also apparently spent some time learning how to perform tea ceremonies.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why you had these at your house! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, it's amazing how two tea bowls can give off such different vibes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. See what I mean?
However, this is just the tip of the iceberg.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, why don't we start making and drinking some matcha? I'll start us off.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're just having a casual gathering today, so feel free to have some snacks while I do it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, you put some matcha powder into the bowl, pour in some hot water and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It looks so easy when you do it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's very impressive.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't realize that you had to go all whisk-whisk-whisk like that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, nice observation.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The number one reason for doing this is to bring out the aroma! If you mix the matcha powder and hot water together just right, it starts smelling really good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, now that you mention it...
This tea smells very nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, it's ready.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Ooh!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me?! But I don't know how I'm supposed to drink this!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, this is all meant to be super casual. Don't worry about any of that stuff.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Right..!
Then...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Here goes nothing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh... It's not as bitter as I was expecting... Actually, it's really good!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's good to hear.
Your second and third sips should progressively get more flavorful, so I hope you enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, you really do know a lot about this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Not really.
This is all stuff I learned during club activities, and I don't get to go that much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? I think it's really great how you know all this stuff about tea ceremonies!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, if you don't mind, I'd like to have some.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure thing. I'll whip some up right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna have you all try this in a bit, so pay close attention!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Okay!
